> Professional interior and exterior auto detailing in Hartford, Wisconsin,
> serving Washington County and neighbouring Dodge County communities.

## Hours
- Monday – Friday: 8am - 6pm
- Saturday – Sunday: Closed

## Packages and pricing
- Sudz Quick Clean (interior only) - $135 cars / $150 SUVs and trucks.
  Interior vacuum, vinyl/rubber/plastic (VRP) treatment, spot stain removal,
  door jambs cleaned, windows cleaned inside and out.
- Sudz Up VIP Clean (interior + exterior) - $200 cars / $250 SUVs and trucks.
  Everything in the Quick Clean plus exterior hand wash, polish, wheels
  cleaned and tires shined.

Prices may vary based on vehicle condition. Quotes are given before work
starts, not at collection.

## Not offered
Paint protection film and window tinting are NOT offered by this business.

## Services
- Full Interior & Exterior Detail (From $200) — https://sudzupdetail.com/services/full-detail/
  The complete reset — interior and exterior, done in sequence over a full day.
- Interior Detailing (From $135) — https://sudzupdetail.com/services/interior-detailing/
  Compressed air, deep vacuum, extraction, surface treatment and glass — the interior done properly.
- Exterior Detailing (Quoted) — https://sudzupdetail.com/services/exterior-detailing/
  Two-bucket hand wash, iron removal, clay decontamination and protection.
- Odor Removal (Quoted) — https://sudzupdetail.com/services/odor-removal/
  Smoke, pet, mildew and spill odors — found at the source and removed, not masked.
- Paint Correction (Quoted) — https://sudzupdetail.com/services/paint-correction/
  Machine polishing to permanently remove swirls, scratches and oxidation.
- Interior Protection (Quoted) — https://sudzupdetail.com/services/interior-protection/
  Fabric sealant and leather or vinyl coating applied to a freshly detailed interior.
- Ceramic Coating (From $599) — https://sudzupdetail.com/services/ceramic-coating/
  Semi-permanent paint protection — decontamination, prep and coating application.
- Truck & SUV Detailing (From $150) — https://sudzupdetail.com/services/truck-and-suv-detailing/
  Work trucks, family SUVs and third-row vehicles. More space, more time.
